text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon was able to achieve splendid 
results in the Twinkle Series.

After making it through those truly 
precious "first three years" together, we 
were taking a brief breather. Then, one 
day...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Trainy, let's take 'em on one-on-one!

I was challenged to a duel by Hishi 
Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"No, I'm not saying we should race. Our 
physical capabilities are on completely 
different levels, after all."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So let's do something other than a race! 
Anything is fine, I just wanna challenge 
you!
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
What's the matter all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
After everything was over, it suddenly hit 
me. Over these past three years... you've 
grown huge too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I figured going one-on-one with someone 
like you would be insanely thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: How about it, interested?

I have no real reason to refuse. And 
that's how I ended up in a one-on-one 
showdown with Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! If we're talking a showdown, 
it's gotta be the arcade! They've got a 
whole buffet of different games to pick 
from!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
For now, let's keep it simple with a 
best-of-three match!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If you win, I'll cook whatever delicious 
food you want for a whole week!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Instead, if you lose, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll have the Miho girls treat me to some 
of those trendy carrot roll cakes!

And with that, the one-on-one showdown 
began—
(*Tonk!*)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, that's point number five! 
Hehehe, how d'ya like that!

"First, air hockey. I picked it thinking 
physical stats wouldn't matter much... 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Taah! Haah! --All right! Match point!

It was an overwhelming victory for Hishi 
Amazon after all. As for the second race, 
driven by growing frustration—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Waaah, I fell off the cliff again!

A car racing game. Unaccustomed to it, 
they seem to be having a rough time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, calm down! As long as you run 
with a cool head, this kind of thing is 
nothing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Engine at full throttle! The finish line 
is mine!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh...? I lost? —Was I running 
backwards the whole time!?

And so, we won the car race! The final 
showdown is—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, shooting games, punching machines, 
they've got all sorts of stuff, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Something just feels off! Like, this ain't 
the kind of one-on-one I'm lookin' for.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it... I love that feeling of 
locking horns, going toe-to-toe and 
slugging it out, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, how about arm wrestling instead!?

It would defeat the whole purpose of 
coming all the way to the arcade. When I 
told her that—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Anything's fine! Don't sweat the small 
stuff!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
W-Well... between you and me, the odds are 
way too stacked in my favor. I'll give you 
a handicap!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll only use one finger, so feel free to 
use both hands... actually, come at me 
with everything you've got!

With a handicap like this, there's no way 
I can lose. Fired up and ready, the match 
began!
—However...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nwoooooh!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, haven't those two been arm 
wrestling for thirty minutes already?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, you're kidding... You're drenched in 
sweat."

Perhaps due to the exquisite handicap, 
neither side could claim victory easily.

"Muster every last bit of strength and put 
full body weight into the arm. With that, 
Hishi Amazon's arm began to draw closer to 
the floor."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Not half bad, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But... this is where my real race begins!

Hishi Amazon smirks fearlessly before 
me... and suddenly, my arm feels intensely 
heavy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ORAAAHH!!

With a fierce shout of spirit, she flipped 
it over in one swift move.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! That was one hell of a duel! 
Thanks a bunch, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"That guts you showed in arm wrestling 
really thrilled me. You're pretty good 
yourself."

I knew Hishi Amazon had the strength to 
never give up and turn things around even 
when driven into a corner.

Still, seeing it up close carries a 
completely different intensity compared to 
watching from the stands.
choice_data_list:
(All that intensity just for a casual arm 
wrestling match...)

text_block_list.text:
An unfathomable obsession with victory. In 
a real race, it must be on a whole 
different level.

Running through these three years without 
ever letting this die out.

Only now do I truly realize the sheer 
terror of that simplicity.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up, Trainy, spacing out like 
that?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, what's with you? Flattery won't 
get you anything, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Besides... if you ask me, you're the one 
who's truly amazing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You've been giving it your all, aiming for 
victory for three whole years. I know, 
because I was right beside you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Keeping that burning passion alive forever 
isn't something you can do with half-baked 
resolve, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Over these past three years, seeing your 
drive has inspired me time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it was only because I was with you 
that I was able to make it through these 
three years.
It seems that more than I thought—
choice_data_list: (Maybe they were two of a kind after all.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So, yeah— I'm counting on you from here on 
out, partner!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Hmm? What is it, Trainy! What're 
you laughing at!

And so began the days of striving for even 
greater heights alongside Hishi Amazon.
